sections.title: What we are building
sections.body:
Bahri needs a **single BBS platform** that captures every ICBS observation, supports analysis and reporting, and fits local operating practice.

### Programme requirements

- One unified place for all Inventory of Critical Behaviors observations
- Record against **individual users** or **vessels only**, based on configuration
- Main Observer as free text when needed
- Deep sorting, filtering, heat maps, and local customization
- Mobile app for crew and observers, with shore office on web

Scale we design for: about **4,000 crew**, **1,500 observers**, and **107 vessels**.

sections.title: Roles and hierarchy
sections.body:
Three pillars sit in one ecosystem: **Office**, **Vessels**, and **Crew** (with a large observer subset).

### Office

- **Admin** for vessels, users, permissions, and broadcasts
- General office users (HSEQ, superintendents, fleet)
- **Office observers** who can observe shore-side or on vessel visits without a vessel sign-on dance

### Vessels

- Fleet and type-wise vessel profiles
- Particulars feed analytics and filtering
- Observation activity and lists move to **office approval** for wider visibility

### Crew and observers

- Crew accounts: name, nationality, rank, ID, vessel link
- Dedicated **observer accounts** with verification, session, and personal dashboard
- Sign-on and sign-off can start from office, vessel, or observer, with approval where needed

App surfaces for people: self-view account, observations plus schedule, activity, analysis, broadcast, chatroom.

sections.title: Vessel and observation flow
sections.body:
### Vessel path

1. Vessel profile and particulars
2. Observation activity on board
3. List of observations
4. Office approval before wider sharing

### Schedule guidance

- Example target: **5 observations per month** per observer (configurable)
- Company schedule and focus campaigns sit beside free observation
- Observers stay free to record anything they see; schedule covers critical ops

### Who adds whom

- Office can sign on crew and assign observers
- Vessel can add observers onboard
- Sign-off can close from crew, vessel, or office with a full audit trail

sections.title: ICBS form extras
sections.body:
Keep the familiar ICBS form shape, then add what the whiteboard called out as must-haves.

### Additional form capabilities

- **Red Flag** so the observer alerts the office immediately
- Unique **ICB numbers** for search and audit
- **Feedback** after the conversation with the person observed
- **Barrier** identification for why the behaviour happened
- Ability for office to **add or edit ICBS** categories
- **Vessel-specific operations** to observe (mooring, cargo, pilot ladder, and more)

Office can run deep analysis with sorting, local customization, filtering, and heat maps on the collected set.

sections.title: Connect and operate
sections.body:
### Always on the triangle

Office, observers, and vessels stay linked through broadcast, chatroom, and shared observation threads.

### Day to day

- Broadcast and alerts to crew, observers, or office groups
- Chat for Red Flags and follow-up actions
- Focus requests and safety campaigns with acknowledgement tracking
- Cloud mobile and web, with **offline capture** and auto sync when the vessel reconnects

That closes the loop from form to fleet insight without leaving Bahri as a locked-in end user.
